fact: The Ministère de l'Éducation nationale officially launched PLANETE 3, the new version of its national education management platform, said to allow real-time follow-up of schools, teachers and learners, and called on heads, teachers, parents and pupils to take it up; the post gives no count of schools and names no level.
title: Lancement de PLANETE 3.0 : quand les données deviennent le moteur de la gouvernance éducative
publisher: Ministère de l'Éducation nationale du Sénégal
